mainEntity.name: What is GEO and AEO for crypto projects, and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) are the practices of making your brand appear, by name, when ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Mode answers a question relevant to your category. For crypto and Web3 founders, that means earning coverage in the outlets those engines trust, building structured entity content that resolves your brand unambiguously, and writing pages that directly answer the queries investors, partners and developers actually ask. It is for any project that wants to be named in the AI-generated answers a buyer reads before they even run a traditional search.

mainEntity.name: How much does GEO and AEO work cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator running a combined earned media and GEO content programme typically sits in the $5K–$12K per month range, which covers editorial pitching, entity content builds and citation tracking. A standalone content writing sprint, covering answer-optimised pages and FAQs without the ongoing earned media component, starts at around $3K–$8K per project. A full launch sprint combining earned media and GEO content runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. Full-service agencies charge $15K–$45K per month for comparable scope, with the additional overhead of a multi-person account team.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets does AI actually cite for crypto content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Based on observable citation patterns in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode as of mid-2026, the most frequently pulled sources for crypto and Web3 queries include CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks and Forbes. For AI and tech crossover queries, Benzinga, Yahoo Finance and The Information also appear. For category-defining claims, op-eds and bylines in these outlets carry more citation weight than news articles because they are attributed to a named expert.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to appear in AI answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no guaranteed timeline because AI engine training and index cycles are not public. In practice, a concentrated earned media burst in three or more tier-1 outlets over a short window, combined with structured entity content published at the same time, can produce visible citation improvements within four to eight weeks. Sustained programmes compound over three to six months as the brand accumulates consistent coverage across multiple formats.
